data.name: GuestOsWindows11Caveat
data.value: Windows 11 requires TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot. Neither is possible here: swtpm is missing from QEMU's Windows builds, and Secure Boot needs the SMM mode that the WHPX hypervisor does not provide. The profile therefore stays plain UEFI, and WinQEMU lifts the hardware requirements check by itself: during installation, the machine gets a "WINQEMU" USB stick whose answer file tells Windows Setup to skip it.

data.name: GuestOsVirtioCaveat
data.value: Windows has no built-in virtio driver, so the disk uses SATA, which works without one. For better performance, provide the virtio-win ISO and switch the disk back to virtio after installation.

data.name: GuestOsWindows7Caveat
data.value: These versions do not handle UEFI reliably under QEMU: the firmware stays BIOS and the disk IDE.
